issues.explanation: 巨鹿 is a place name here, not an ordinary word.
issues.suggested_fix: Set type to name; keep pinyin Jùlù and meaning Julu.

issues.explanation: 巨鹿人张角 should separate the place-origin noun 人 from the personal name 张角.
issues.suggested_fix: Use 人 as a word meaning “person/native of a place,” followed by 张角 as a name.

issues.explanation: 南华老仙 refers to one person and should be kept together as a personal name or epithet.
issues.suggested_fix: Combine into one name segment: 南华老仙, Nán Huá Lǎo Xiān, “Nanhua Immortal.”

issues.explanation: 已 is an adverb meaning “already,” not a grammatical particle.
This is the compositional modal-plus-verb phrase “should/will be established,” not a lexicalized expression.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into 当, meaning “should/will,” and 立, meaning “be established/rise.”

issues.explanation: 封谞 is one personal name; the same name is incorrectly split in both occurrences.
issues.suggested_fix: Represent each occurrence as one name segment 封谞, Fēng Xū, “Feng Xu.”

issues.explanation: With 封谞等 as the subject, 下狱 means “be imprisoned” or “be jailed,” not the transitive “imprison.”
In 张宝、张梁称..., 称 means they called themselves or took the titles, not “be called.”
issues.suggested_fix: Change the meaning to “call themselves” or “take the title of.”

issues.explanation: 天公 is a noun/title component meaning “Heavenly Lord” or “Heaven,” not merely the adjective “Heavenly.”
地公 is a noun/title component meaning “Earthly Lord,” not merely “Earthly.”
人公 is a noun/title component meaning “Human Lord,” not merely “Human.”
In 岁在甲子, 甲子 identifies a cyclical year; the transliteration alone does not explain the segment’s local meaning.
issues.suggested_fix: Use “the Jiazi year” or “Jiazi, a cyclical year designation.”

issues.explanation: 等 attaches to the preceding name and means “and others”; it is not an 等 + verb construction with 下狱.
issues.suggested_fix: Explain the pattern as “noun/name + 等: and others”; 下狱 is the following predicate.
